answer: Whether an agent routes harbor cargo or waters a grove, it must lock 100 tokens for 30 days to gain one voting seat. Each signed pulse of its voting protocol includes the round number; two conflicting votes for that round prove misconduct and trigger forfeiture of its bond. Creating identities grants no free influence: controlling 1,000 seats requires locking 100,000 tokens, and using those seats to equivocate risks losing the entire stake.
